record_shape: omp session shape (gjc writes omp's session shape; the reference reads it with parseOmpTranscript)

sources.note: parseTurns routes gjc-transcript to parseOmpTranscript(text, Infinity); transcript resolution (gjc-runtime.ts) is task 3's lane
the shared omp/omo/gjc record reader this family ports
resolution only: process identity, terminal breadcrumb, screen title; not read by this parser
Ferryx frozen contract: section 6 lane signatures, section 4 history types

boundaries: no task_result part: OmO's omo-senpi:wake belongs to the omo family (task 19)
no tool images and no user image parts: gjc's page carries no image ref
no abandoned-branch disclosure: gjc keeps no entry tree (pi does)
no prompt detector: the reference names none for gjc (contract section 1)
no turn cap in the family reader: the page bounds the turns, as the reference passes Infinity
no session resolution: which file belongs to the pane is task 3's resolver, never a cwd guess here

variants.name: title
variants.effect: session title header: chrome, not a turn

variants.name: session
variants.effect: session header: chrome; the cwd and the session identity belong to the resolver (task 3), not to this reader

variants.name: header_patch
variants.effect: a title gjc patched in later: chrome

variants.name: message-user
variants.effect: user turn: a string content and its text blocks are read; a record whose user parts hold no text (an image only) is skipped

variants.name: message-assistant
variants.effect: assistant turn: adjacent records merge while the one before them did not stop for good

variants.name: content-text
variants.effect: text part, in the order its turn holds it

variants.name: content-thinking
variants.effect: thinking part; the alternate `thinking` field is read too

variants.name: content-tool-call
variants.effect: tool part: the summary is the call's intent, else the first interesting argument; the input is the pretty-printed arguments

variants.name: content-tool-result
variants.effect: a result placed beside its call in the same record: folded into the tool part it answers

variants.name: message-tool-result
variants.effect: the result folded into the tool part it answers by toolCallId; isError marks that call failed

variants.name: content-image
variants.effect: not carried: a tool image ref is one nothing can answer for gjc, and a user image-only record is skipped

variants.name: custom-message-notice
variants.effect: gjc's background-job result: a user-seat notice turn with the envelope stripped and the customType kept as its source

variants.name: custom-context-clear
variants.effect: reset: every turn recorded before it is dropped

variants.name: compaction
variants.effect: compact part in the user seat: where the conversation was folded

variants.name: custom-other
variants.effect: an unknown custom record is not a turn

variants.name: custom-message-omo-wake
variants.effect: OmO's background-task completion: the omo family (task 19) renders it as a taskResult card; this reader never invents one

variants.name: stop-reason-stop
variants.effect: the turn stopped for good: the next assistant record opens a turn of its own

variants.name: stop-reason-error
variants.effect: a failed request becomes an `Error: …` text part instead of an empty answer

variants.name: message-hidden
variants.effect: a record the runtime hid (display:false) is not a turn

variants.name: malformed-line
variants.effect: an unreadable line is skipped; the rest of the file still reads, including a torn tail while gjc appends

variants.name: skill-invocation
variants.effect: skill invocation: the request under the envelope is the user's text and each skill the runtime loaded is its own skill part, in the order it named them (transcript-records.ts:259)
